name: Organized Complete
notes: V2.0.0 adopts the reorganized V1.0.0-to-V2.0.0 product history and treats the complete local-first finance, ledger, budget, reporting, projects, productivity, encrypted Cloud Schema V3 synchronization, responsive UI, PWA delivery, and final Budget & Expenses mascot experience as one organized production release. Existing Finance Schema 12, Cloud Schema V3, saved records, calculations, balances, recurrence, payments, storage, encryption, and synchronization semantics are preserved.
